name: Narotam Sekhsaria Foundation Postgraduate Scholarship Programme 2026

rules.quote: Applicant must be an Indian national, residing in India
Applicant must be below 30 years of age as of January 31, 2026

rules.value: graduate of accredited Indian university (final-year students eligible)
rules.quote: Applicant must have graduated from an accredited Indian University
Applicants planning to pursue Postgraduate studies at institutions in India and abroad from Fall 2026.

rules.value: merit-based, need-blind; repayable interest-free loan scholarship; Rs 500 application fee
rules.quote: The programme offers full and part scholarships as repayable interest free financial assistance.
The award of scholarship is subject to securing admission.

amount.text: Full or part scholarship as repayable interest-free financial assistance (amount not printed)
amount.quote: The programme offers full and part scholarships as repayable interest free financial assistance.

documents.name: UG/PG mark sheets (attested)
documents.quote: Attested copies of the mark sheets of all years of the under-graduate study and post-graduate study, if any

documents.name: Score cards (GRE/GMAT/CAT/GATE)
documents.quote: Attested copies of score cards of any qualifying examination taken. (E.g. GRE, GMAT, CAT, GATE, etc.)

documents.name: University acceptance letter with fee structure
documents.quote: University Acceptance letter with the fee structure

documents.name: Co-applicant ITR, passport
documents.quote: Latest Income Tax Returns of co-applicant

deadline.text: Applications closed for 2026; invited every January
deadline.quote: All applications for the Narotam Sekhsaria’s scholarships for post-graduation are invited by the Foundation in the month of January for every academic year.
